research_objective: Minimize worst-case predicted distribution-network electrical stress while satisfying hard grid, mobility, storage, AI-service, and recovery constraints.
common_formulation_rule: B00-B09 use one H54 formulation and objective; only capability, replan-policy, and risk-interface masks may differ according to the frozen registry.

stress_components.voltage_planning: limit-normalized LinDistFlow squared-voltage epigraph; 0 at 1 pu and 1 at 0.95/1.05 pu

planning_to_evaluation_semantics: The causal planner minimizes a radial-network surrogate with the same physical limit endpoints; the paper-facing realized KPI is recomputed from Fresh three-phase OpenDSS voltage magnitudes and current/kVA loadings.
hard_constraints: MESS route, connection, SOC, PCS P-Q circle
GPU gang, rack, IDC, WAN, checkpoint, deadline
terminal workload debt and support-energy debt recovery
excluded_from_optimization_objective: electricity price or ex-post grid cost
